claim: A deep generative model can generate multi-target molecules that are valid, novel, and effective for various complex diseases, demonstrating robustness and generalization across different target pairs.
falsifier: One can train a deep generative model on multi-target ligand data and evaluate the validity, novelty, and effectiveness of generated molecules across multiple target pairs using standard metrics.

conditions: the model is trained on multi-target ligand data
the generation is performed for various target pairs
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported model (MTMol-GPT) and the target pairs and diseases studied; transfer beyond these is unestablished.

title: Generative model to multiple for generation of valid, novel
